body: Part of e553ce, after 9e23ea. skywave-core: apply capture events to the replica and expose them in ViewState; the outbox rule from dc27f7 for inputs (no blind resend after a long drop; settle a stale refusal as discardable); captures follow the blob policy, but the latest capture of an open screen downloads eagerly. Link-harness tests: a tap queued offline, a drop mid-capture download, two devices tapping at once.
title: screen 4: core replica and outbox rules for screen inputs
